lastPrompt:
Edit this MLOps Platform dashboard with these major layout and design changes. Keep the same dark monocromatic palette (#09090b, #18181b, #27272a, #a1a1aa, #fafafa) and the sidebar exactly as it is.

CHANGE 1 - HEADER ROW: Redesign the header area. Left side: "Dashboard" bold white text. Center: compact inline metrics as plain text in a single line, no cards, no icons, no backgrounds — just: "5 repos · 23 pipelines · 3 modelos · 87.2% accuracy" where numbers are font-semibold white and labels are small gray #52525b text, separated by subtle dot separators (·). Right side: keep the three health indicator dots (Backend Healthy, MLflow Healthy, Model Server Warning).

CHANGE 2 - REMOVE THE 4 BIG STAT CARDS completely. No more big cards with numbers. The metrics are now inline in the header as described above.

CHANGE 3 - REPOSITORIOS as compact horizontal chips: Below the header, show repositories as small compact horizontal chip/tag elements in a single row. Each chip is approximately 48px tall, pill-shaped with border #27272a, containing only: repo name + "main" branch badge + small green/red status dot. No date, no notebook path, no delete icon, no GitHub icon. Compact, minimal, like tags. Example chips: "fraud-detection-model main ●", "sentiment-analyzer main ●", "recommender-sys main ●"

CHANGE 4 - PIPELINES RECIENTES TABLE as the main protagonist: Full width table below the repo chips, taking up most of the screen. No card wrapper, the table integrates directly into the #09090b background. Bigger, more spacious rows. Columns: Status (refined colored badges - success=green, running=blue with animated dot, failed=red, queued=yellow/gray), Pipeline ID (monospace), Repositorio, Commit (short hash), Duración, Fecha, Accuracy (new column at the end showing percentages like 92.1%, 87.5%, etc). Show 6-7 rows. Subtle alternating row backgrounds. This table should be the visual centerpiece of the dashboard.

CHANGE 5 - AREA CHART at the bottom: Replace the bar chart. Full width area chart below the table titled "Actividad del Pipeline". Area chart with a thin white line and a subtle gradient fill from rgba(255,255,255,0.08) at the top fading to transparent at the bottom. Very subtle grid lines in #27272a. Day labels (Lun, Mar, Mié, Jue, Vie, Sáb, Dom) in #52525b. Minimal Y-axis. No card border, integrates into the #09090b background. Professional, clean, like Linear or Vercel analytics charts.

OVERALL: Premium, clean, data-dense dashboard. The pipeline table dominates. Everything else is compact and supportive. Same dark theme, same sidebar. 4K resolution, pixel-perfect.
